description: #453/#37 — soft delete: the space, every database and record inside it. Recoverable via restore_space (see list_spaces_trash) as long as it stays undone — this tool does not warn "irreversible" the way it used to, because it no longer is one. Guardrail: `confirm` must equal the space name exactly, the same rule delete_database enforces for a smaller action. An empty space needs no confirm.

confirm.description: Must equal the space name exactly. Required when the space still holds databases.

name: delete_space
title: Delete space
